name: dsh-busy-light
description: Busy board for the DSH Web GUI: a draggable tree panel — blue breathing for running Sessions, loud amber with a 待审批/待回答/待确认 tag for Sessions blocked on you, green for background completions that stay until you open that Session. Subagents hang off their parent as an indented branch; a finished Session whose subagents still work stays a muted context row instead of claiming done. Rows open their Session, the board remembers its seat, and the browser tab counts root Sessions only with self-healing icons and a breathing badge.
